summary: Automatic updates no longer undo each other overnight.

fixes.title: Updates no longer undo each other
fixes.text: A new version is marked as approved only after a clean build, so the nightly update and the build no longer pull in opposite directions.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: A failed save of the approved version is reported at once, and the updater cannot be installed on a version too old to run it.
